topic: Day 33 — carousel — Character shows in how you handle being wrong, not being right

slides.text: Everyone is wrong regularly, without exception.
What differs is admitting it without collapsing your image.
Defensiveness under correction reveals more than any accuracy record.

caption:
Everyone is wrong regularly. The trait that differentiates people is whether they can admit it quickly, without collapsing their self-image.

Follow for one of these a day.
